name: mi-lsp
summary: Local CLI that indexes repos to find code, read exact ranges, and follow canonical docs.
use_cases: Search text and see matching code inline
Read one or more exact file ranges
See what a change affects (callers, tests, docs)
features: Search text with matching code inline
Navigate canonical wiki and governance docs

usage_guide.open_hint: In your repository folder, run `mi-lsp init . --name <workspace> --format toon` to index it as a workspace.

features.title: Find a symbol by name
steps: Index your repo with `mi-lsp init . --name <workspace> --format toon`.
Run `mi-lsp nav find <symbol> --workspace <workspace> --format toon` to get the file, line and definition.

features.feature: Search text with matching code inline
features.title: Search text and see matching code inline
steps: Index your repo with `mi-lsp init . --name <workspace> --format toon`.
Run `mi-lsp nav search "<your text>" --workspace <workspace> --repo <repo> --include-content --format toon` to see matches with their code lines.

features.title: Read exact line ranges from one or more files
steps: Index your repo with `mi-lsp init . --name <workspace> --format toon`.
Run `mi-lsp nav multi-read <file>:<start>-<end> <file>:<start>-<end> --workspace <workspace> --format toon` to print those lines.

    return attempt + 1
PY
cat src/app.py && mkdir -p myapp 2>/dev/null; echo setup-done

smoke_tests.command: mi-lsp nav find hello_world --workspace myapp --format toon 2>&1

setup.command:
mkdir -p src/billing tests/billing .docs/wiki/05_requirements && cat > src/billing/retry.py <<'EOF'
"""Billing retry logic sample."""
RETRY_LIMIT = 3

def billing_retry(order_id, attempts=RETRY_LIMIT):
    """Retry billing for order."""
    for i in range(attempts):
        if charge(order_id):
            return True
    return False

def charge(order_id):
    """Charge order."""
    return True
EOF
cat > tests/billing/retry_test.py <<'EOF'
from src.billing.retry import billing_retry
def test_billing_retry():
    assert billing_retry("order-123") is True
EOF
cat > .docs/wiki/05_requirements/RF-GPH-010.md <<'EOF'
# RF-GPH-010 - Billing retry spec
Billing retry governs how the daemon restarts failed charges.
See billing_retry symbol.
EOF
echo SETUP_DONE && ls -R src tests .docs

smoke_tests.command: mi-lsp nav find billing_retry --workspace myapp --format toon

what_it_does.quote: A local CLI that answers "where is X" and "what does the spec say" without an agent burning its context window to find out.

who_it_is_for.quote: Who it's for:** developers navigating an unfamiliar or large repository, and coding agents that need reliable, bounded, token-cheap navigation

config_and_keys.quote: **`MI_LSP_BIN`.** When set, it must point at the real executable — `mi-lsp.exe` on Windows, `mi-lsp` elsewhere.

troubleshooting_uninstall.quote: **`daemon status` warns the executable is stale** (its hash doesn't match this CLI build).

license_and_platforms.quote: Public release bundles cover Windows (`win-x64`, `win-arm64`), Linux (`linux-x64`, `linux-arm64`), and macOS (`darwin-x64`, `darwin-arm64`).
